NULL) UNION ALL SELECT subtree.root,g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN subtree ON g.parent_group_id=subtree.gid), per_week AS (SELECT s.root, CAST(strftime('%W',date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4')) AS INTEGER)+1 AS wk, COUNT(*) n FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment a ON a.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<a.valid_to) JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=a.merchant_id JOIN subtree s ON s.gid=m.group_id WHERE t.ts_utc>='2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.root,wk), sums AS (SELECT g.group_id,g.name, COALESCE(p.wk,0) wk, COALESCE(p.n,0) n FROM dim_merchant_group g CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 wk UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IS NULL)) SELECT name, ROUND((52.0*SUM(wk*n)-SUM(wk)*SUM(n))/(52.0*SUM(wk*wk)-SUM(wk)*SUM(wk)),4) slope FROM sums GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY slope DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH x AS (SELECT s.settled_at,ABS(ROUND(t.amount_minor*1.0/pow(10,c.exponent)*f.eur_per_unit*100)-s.settled_eur_minor) diff FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=substr(s.settled_at,1,10)) SELECT strftime('%Y',date(settled_at,'-3 days','weekday 4'))||'-W'||printf('%02d',CAST(strftime('%W',date(settled_at,'-3 days','weekday 4')) AS INTEGER)+1) wk,SUM(diff) amount_diff FROM x GROUP BY wk ORDER BY amount_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH RECURSIVE groups(gid,id) AS (SELECT g.group_id,g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN dim_merchant_group p ON p.group_id=g.parent_group_id WHERE p.parent_group_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT groups.gid,c.group_id FROM groups JOIN dim_merchant_group c ON c.parent_group_id=groups.id), weeks(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM weeks WHERE x<52), weekly AS (SELECT groups.gid,CAST(strftime('%W',t.ts_utc) AS INT)+1 x,COUNT(*) n FROM groups JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.group_id=groups.id JOIN terminal_assignment a ON a.merchant_id=m.merchant_id JOIN txn t ON t.terminal_id=a.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<a.valid_to) WHERE t.ts_utc>='2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY groups.gid,x), totals AS (SELECT g.gid,SUM(COALESCE(w.n,0)) sy,SUM(weeks.x*COALESCE(w.n,0)) sxy FROM (SELECT DISTINCT gid FROM groups) g CROSS JOIN weeks LEFT JOIN weekly w ON w.gid=g.gid AND w.x=weeks.x GROUP BY g.gid) SELECT d.name,(52.0*totals.sxy-1378.0*totals.sy)/(52.0*22100-1378.0*1378) slope FROM totals JOIN dim_merchant_group d ON d.group_id=totals.gid ORDER BY slope DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH RECURSIVE descendants(root_id,gid) AS (SELECT group_id,group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE level=2 AND parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE level=1) UNION ALL SELECT d.root_id,g.group_id FROM descendants d JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.parent_group_id=d.gid), weeks(w) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT w+1 FROM weeks WHERE w<52), counts AS (SELECT d.root_id, CAST((julianday(date(t.ts_utc))-julianday('2025-01-01')+2)/7 AS INTEGER)+1 AS w, count(*) n FROM txn t JOIN dim_terminal dt ON dt.terminal_id=t.terminal_id JOIN terminal_assignment a ON a.terminal_id=dt.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<a.valid_to) JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=a.merchant_id JOIN descendants d ON d.gid=m.group_id WHERE t.ts_utc>='2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.root_id,w), series AS (SELECT g.group_id,g.name,weeks.w,coalesce(counts.n,0) y FROM dim_merchant_group g CROSS JOIN weeks LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.root_id=g.group_id AND counts.w=weeks.w WHERE g.level=2 AND g.parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE level=1)) SELECT name, sum((w-26.5)*(y-avg_y))/sum((w-26.5)*(w-26.5)) slope FROM (SELECT *,avg(y) OVER(PARTITION BY group_id) avg_y FROM series) GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY slope DESC;

WITH diffs AS (SELECT s.settled_at, ABS(ROUND((t.amount_minor * 1.0 / (10.0 * c.exponent)) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) - s.settled_eur_minor) AS diff FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=substr(s.settled_at,1,10)) SELECT strftime('%Y',date(settled_at,'-3 days','weekday 4')) || '-W' || strftime('%W',date(settled_at,'-3 days','weekday 4')) AS iso_week, SUM(diff) AS total_diff FROM diffs GROUP BY iso_week ORDER BY total_diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH diffs AS (SELECT s.settled_at, ABS(ROUND((t.amount_minor * 1.0 / CASE c.exponent WHEN 0 THEN 1.0 WHEN 2 THEN 100.0 WHEN 3 THEN 1000.0 WHEN 4 THEN 10000.0 ELSE 100.0 END) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) - s.settled_eur_minor) AS diff FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=substr(s.settled_at,1,10)) SELECT strftime('%Y',date(settled_at,'-3 days','weekday 4')) || '-W' || strftime('%W',date(settled_at,'-3 days','weekday 4')) AS iso_week, SUM(diff) AS total_diff FROM diffs GROUP BY iso_week ORDER BY total_diff DESC LIMIT 5

WITH x AS (SELECT s.settled_at, t.amount_minor, c.exponent, f.eur_per_unit, s.settled_eur_minor, date(s.settled_at) d FROM settlement s JOIN txn t USING(txn_id) JOIN dim_currency c USING(currency_id) JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=date(s.settled_at)), y AS (SELECT *, date(d,'-3 days','weekday 4') thu FROM x) SELECT strftime('%Y',thu)||'-W'||printf('%02d',(CAST(strftime('%j',thu) AS INT)-1)/7+1) week, SUM(ABS(ROUND(amount_minor*1.0/CASE exponent WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 10 WHEN 2 THEN 100 WHEN 3 THEN 1000 WHEN 4 THEN 10000 ELSE 100 END * eur_per_unit *100)-settled_eur_minor)) diff FROM y GROUP BY week ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
